trial_court: Administrative Civil Judge− Cum− Additional Rent Controller (Central) : Delhi (Petition No. : 302/2008)
case_name: Rita vs Union Of India on 9 October, 2014

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Rita and others (husband, wife, plaintiff)
parties.respondent_defendant: Union Of India and others (defendant, respondent)

facts_of_case: Smt. Rita filed a succession petition for herself and her two minor children, Baby Prerna and Master Hardek, to grant them a succession certificate in their favor qua the debts and securities left by Sh. Jai Rajan.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person claiming to be the legally wedded wife to prove her case.
legal_principles.held: She stated that her husband Jairajan Paniker was working with Indian Air Force and expired on 12.07.2006 at Delhi.

legal_principles.principle: The name of the wife in the service record is conclusive evidence.
legal_principles.held: The said CGHS card was wrongly issued to the petitioner Rita. Court observation is made to the effect that the name of wife of the deceased has been mentioned in his service record as Anita.

outcome.final_order: The trial court granted the petitioners' request for a succession certificate.
